_note: Canonical hardware classes for measurements.json rows. hardware_id is a CHIP CLASS, not a machine: the legacy `hardware` strings do not say whether an M4-base row came from the Mac mini (Mac16,10, macOS 27.0.1) or the MacBook Air (Mac16,13, macOS 26.6.2, added 2026-10-27). No existing row mentions the Air. Machine-level attribution stays in the row's command / source report; it is never guessed here. The original `hardware` string of every row is kept untouched.

values.m4-base: Apple M4 base (h16g): Mac mini M4 16 GB historical corpus; also the Air M4 since 2026-10-27 (see _note)
values.m5-max: Apple M5 Max (h17c), Mac Studio 128 GB, Mac17,14
values.apple-other-external: Apple chip we never owned, quoted from a third party or paper (M3 Max, M4 Max GPU, M5 H17s)
values.non-apple-external: Non-Apple hardware quoted from a third party (Ryzen 5 3600, RTX 3090)
values.unknown: Row carries no hardware string and no source states it
